verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Your cross, Your cross
It draws me to Your heart
It makes my spirit sing
It makes my spirit sing

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your grace, Your grace
O I hear it call my name
I'm waking up to sing
I'm waking up to sing

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We will sing and shout, sing and shout
Open up our hearts
And pour Your praises out

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
We will sing and shout, sing and shout,
Open up our hearts
and pour Your praises out

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Because, because
Because Your love came down
It makes me want to sing
It makes me want to sing

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Because because
Because You called my name
I'm waking up to sing
I'm waking up to sing

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
What could be better than a grace
That washes all our shame away?
What could be better than Your great love?

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
What could be better than a grace
That leads us home and makes a way?
What could be better than Your great love?
